name: Virtual WAN hub
summary: Microsoft-managed hub-and-spoke networking: a Virtual WAN and one regional hub, with spoke VNets connected to it, as an alternative to a hand-built hub VNet with peerings.
useWhen: You need hub-and-spoke networking across many regions or many spokes, and want Microsoft to manage the hub's routing
You need branch/VPN/ExpressRoute connectivity into the hub at scale
avoidWhen: A single hand-built hub VNet (this repo's virtual-network module) with peerings is enough for a small number of spokes in one region
